newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia trade data justifies rate cut-opp'n.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia trade data justifies rate cut-opp'n.

text.p: Australian opposition treasury spokesman Gareth Evans said on Monday the August current account deficit data reinforced the argument for another cut in official interest rates.
Evans said the data confirmed that overall economic activity was very subdued.

"The case is now very strong for a further interest rate cut of at least half a percent -- and Labor believes that the Reserve Bank board should decide accordingly at its meeting tomorrow," Evans said in a statement. "Interest rates need to be cut to kickstart jobs growth and rebuild shattered confidence."
